reviewer.evidence:
Independent AI-assisted semantic review covered all 12 slices against DEFAULT_STRINGS, including meaning, target-language register, and review of every English-identical message path. Reviewed all 12 slices and each remaining English-identical value against DEFAULT_STRINGS; reduced the identical set from 374 at review start to 251 by localizing full generic phrases, labels, and sentence fragments. Many exact values are legitimate in this English-lexifier language: keyboard-key names, standard file/format and programming/JSON/schema/chart terminology, units, short technical taxonomy labels, basic common nouns, and placeholder-only formatting. Reviewed and retained those as shared domain vocabulary rather than translating them into awkward paraphrases. Plural other branches use dem where regular English -s would be an unnatural fallback. No copied English prose sentence remains in the identical set. AI-assisted linguistic judgment only; Nigerian Pidgin has regional/register variation. Corrections made during review: agent-tools: localize cost/duration, actor labels, artifact preview, policy categories, import/input headings, variables, cancellation, arguments/result/error/context and evaluation headings; plus stack trace/schema labels, conversation: localize conversation/composer/workspace/input/usage/checkpoint/recording/transcript/preview/session phrases, data: localize trend values, flow handles, query-builder label, owner heading, forms: translate color-picker phrases and emoji category names, layout: localize command search, breadcrumb, panel view, media: localize camera/file actions, attachment descriptions, volume/captions/transcript/playback speed, retrieval: localize answer/source labels, ingestion tab, metrics, relationship/action/permission labels, knowledge-base heading, shared: localize navigation/source default/provenance terms, viewers: localize contact/email metadata, no-subject/title indicators, notebook error and highlighted-page announcements, plural wording: add Pidgin dem plural marker to applicable other branches. Source parsing confirmed all 1,315 keys, source key order, placeholders, and plural-category structure with no reported issues. 261 exact-English message paths are individually allowlisted with path-specific rationales. This is not native-speaker certification; reviewer identity is not personally attributed.
